conventions.testing: Unit tests in mod tests blocks with tree-sitter parsing verification
conventions.linting: clippy with deny rules for undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used
conventions.error_handling: Option types for nullable results, Vec<String> for collections

patterns: LanguageInfo struct with optional query fields and handler functions
ELEMENT_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY constants in language-specific modules
EXTENSION_MAP mapping file extensions to language identifiers
extract_inheritance handler for class/interface inheritance extraction

related_issues.title: Add Swift grammar support via tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3

constraints: Must follow existing language registration pattern (model after java.rs)
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for defuse_query field in LanguageInfo
All languages are unconditionally compiled in (no feature gates)
test_coverage: Existing languages have unit tests in mod tests blocks verifying ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, and extract_inheritance. Tests parse sample code and verify capture extraction.

library_findings.notes: Published by alex-pinkus, MIT license, 0.23.x tree-sitter API compatible
Core parsing library used by all language handlers

approaches.name: Full Java-style integration
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler following java.rs pattern exactly

approaches.name: Minimal integration
approaches.description: Add swift.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and basic queries, skip DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance

approaches.name: CSS-style lightweight integration
approaches.description: Follow css.rs pattern with ELEMENT_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY only, no DEFUSE_QUERY

recommendation: Full Java-style integration - provides complete feature parity and follows the issue's explicit reference to java.rs as the model. DEFUSE_QUERY is required for proper defuse tracking which is a core capability of the analyzer.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

inheritance_walk_citation: Based on tree-sitter-swift grammar.ts structure: class_declaration has 'inheritance_clause' field containing 'type_inheritance_clause' with 'superclass_specifier' (for superclass) and 'protocol_inheritance_clause' (for protocols). The superclass is accessed via 'superclass' field under 'inheritance_clause', and protocols via 'protocols' field. Each protocol/type is a 'type_identifier' or 'user_type' node.
